items.hermes: Python 3.11+
items.notes: Different stacks, different ecosystems

items.hermes: MIT (open source)
items.notes: Hermes fully open; Claude Code source visible via npm sourcemap but proprietary

items.hermes: run_agent.py → AIAgent class with OpenAI-compatible tool calling loop
items.claude_code: Internal agentic loop with extended thinking + tool use
items.notes: Both implement tool-calling agent loops. Claude Code has extended thinking advantage

items.hermes: None — 200+ models via OpenRouter, Nous Portal, OpenAI, custom endpoints
items.claude_code: Claude models only (Opus, Sonnet, Haiku) via Anthropic/Bedrock/Vertex
items.notes: Fundamental architectural difference. Hermes model-agnostic by design
Hermes has 3x more tools but many are domain-specific (HA, TTS, image gen)

items.hermes: file_tools.py, file_operations.py, patch_parser.py
items.notes: Both capable. Claude Code Edit is more precise (diff-based vs full rewrite)

items.hermes: terminal_tool.py with persistent shell, 7 execution backends
items.claude_code: Bash tool with sandboxing, timeout, background execution
items.notes: Hermes wins on execution backends (Docker/SSH/Modal). Claude Code wins on sandboxing

items.hermes: web_tools.py (Exa, Firecrawl, parallel-web)
items.notes: Hermes has more search providers. Claude Code integrated natively

items.hermes: browser_tool.py + browser_camofox.py (anti-detection)
items.notes: Hermes: Camoufox anti-detection. Claude Code: Chrome native integration

items.hermes: mcp_tool.py + mcp_oauth.py (client)
items.claude_code: Full MCP client (stdio, HTTP, SSE) + server capabilities
items.notes: Both support MCP. Claude Code has broader transport support

items.hermes: code_execution_tool.py (sandboxed Python/JS execution)
todo_tool.py
MEMORY.md + USER.md (§-delimited, char-bounded) + pluggable backends (Honcho, vector+BM25)
items.notes: Both have persistent memory. Hermes has pluggable backends. Claude Code has rules system

items.hermes: SQLite FTS5 + Gemini Flash summarization across ALL past sessions
items.claude_code: /resume lists sessions. No full-text search. File-based memory only
items.notes: Major Hermes advantage. Can answer 'what did we discuss last week about X?'

items.hermes: skill_manager_tool creates/edits/deletes SKILL.md autonomously + skills_guard security scan
items.claude_code: Skills are manually authored. No auto-generation mechanism
items.notes: Hermes creates reusable procedural knowledge from experience. Claude Code cannot

items.hermes: 73 built-in + 14 optional packs + Skills Hub marketplace + agentskills.io standard
items.claude_code: Custom skills only (.claude/skills/). No marketplace. No sharing protocol
items.notes: Hermes has rich ecosystem. Claude Code skills are project-local

items.hermes: Basic file reading + terminal grep. No specialized code tools
items.claude_code: Specialized Read/Edit/Grep/Glob + 200K context + extended thinking + sub-agents
items.notes: Major Claude Code advantage. Purpose-built for code understanding

items.hermes: Terminal-based git. No native GitHub integration
items.claude_code: Native git operations + gh CLI + PR creation + GitHub Actions + auto-fix PRs
items.notes: Claude Code is deeply integrated with Git/GitHub workflows

items.hermes: None (terminal-only)
items.claude_code: VS Code extension + JetBrains plugins + remote development
items.notes: Claude Code major advantage for developer workflow

items.hermes: Not benchmarked (uses OpenHands delegation, Issue #477)
items.notes: Claude Code is top-tier for code generation benchmarks

items.hermes: CLI + 15 messaging platforms (Telegram, Discord, Slack, WhatsApp, Signal, Email, SMS, Matrix, Mattermost, Feishu, WeCom, DingTalk, HomeAssistant, Webhook, API)
items.claude_code: CLI + IDE (VS Code, JetBrains) + Web app + Desktop app
items.notes: Different focus: Hermes=messaging everywhere, Claude Code=development everywhere

items.hermes: Local, Docker, SSH, Modal, Managed Modal, Daytona, Singularity
items.notes: Hermes much more flexible for infrastructure

items.notes: Hermes dramatically cheaper for high-volume use

items.notes: Both capable. Hermes delivers to any platform. Claude Code cloud-managed

items.hermes: 5 TTS providers + local STT + push-to-talk voice mode
items.notes: Hermes bidirectional voice. Claude Code input-only
